requirements.note: Newest first; sender, subject, preview capped at two lines, Oct 24 / time; blue dot on unread rows; rows grow for 2-line previews.
Leading swipe toggles Read/Unread, trailing swipe offers Flag + Archive, a full swipe archives; 'Message archived — Undo' toast; Archive screen lists archived mail with its own unread count.
Flag from swipe and from the reader toolbar; flag icon on row; All/Unread/Flagged filter works (23 flagged).
Reader shows subject, avatar initials, full date, body; opening dropped unread 109→108; toolbar Mark Unread / Flag / Archive.
Pull to refresh adds two new unread messages at the top stamped with the current time; repeated pulls add more.
'N unread' shown under the search field and updated live; Archive shows its own count.
After relaunch read, flagged, archived states and the refreshed messages all survived.

tells: Filter is a custom segmented control with a solid blue selected pill, not the system segmented control look
No large title: 'Inbox' is a small centred inline title from the start, unlike Mail
'320 messages / 109 unread' summary line between the search field and the list feels like it was added by hand
Swipe actions are circular buttons with captions below, not standard full-height UIContextualAction blocks
Disclosure chevron on every mail row
A.scroll: Slow drags, flings and fling-back were smooth with no blank or popping rows; pull past the top refreshes; scroll position kept when returning from Archive.

requirements.note: Newest first with sender, subject, preview, Mail-style dates (time / weekday / 10/20/26) and a blue unread dot. At the largest text size the preview isn't capped at two lines and runs on for 5+ lines, clipped by the next row.
Trailing swipe Flag + Archive, full swipe archives, leading swipe Mark Read/Unread; Archive screen works. No undo after archiving.
Flag from swipe and from the message nav bar; orange flag on row; filter menu (All Mail/Unread/Flagged) with checkmark works.
Reader shows subject, sender, To, date, body; opening dropped unread 109→108.
Pull to refresh (also a refresh button) adds two new unread messages at the top with the current time.
'N unread' subtitle under the large title, updated live.
After relaunch read, flagged, archived states and the refreshed messages persisted.

bugs: At the largest text size the preview isn't limited to two lines and is cut off at the bottom of the row
Archive screen has a refresh button and filter that make no sense there
No undo after archiving, so a mistaken full swipe can only be fixed by finding the message in Archive
tells: A swiped row gets a grey rounded card background, which is not how a list cell behaves
Mark Unread swipe action is a grey capsule rather than the blue system action
When collapsed, the nav bar shows a small left-aligned 'Inbox / 109 unread' with rows showing faintly through it, not the system centred inline title
Rows have fixed height: one-line previews leave a large gap and two-line previews touch the separator, so spacing looks uneven
'Mark as Unread' is a centred text link in the message body rather than a toolbar or nav-bar action
Search field text in the bottom toolbar doesn't grow with Dynamic Type
Row accessibility labels don't say whether a message is unread or flagged (each row is a single button)
Back button is only a chevron with no 'Inbox' label
B.scroll: Flings and slow drags were smooth with no blank rows, and position is kept on return from Archive; the large title collapses but leaves a cramped left-aligned header with content showing through.

why: Both meet every requirement and keep state across relaunch, but A adds an undo toast and keeps previews at two lines. It also adapts its filter into a menu at the largest text size. B has the more Mail-like large title and dates, but its rows have uneven fixed heights and swiped rows get a grey card background. Its previews overflow at large text, and its odd Archive-screen controls make it feel less finished.
